zh: 价格最多2000，目标总价T最多4000，完全可以枚举T。固定T之后，价格x只能和价格T−x配对，不同的价格对之间互不干扰。
对每个T：价格恰为T的商品各自单独成包；价格x小于T−x时两组能配出min(cnt[x],cnt[T−x])包；x等于T−x时同价配对，能配出cnt[x]除以2包。把它们加起来，对所有T取最大值。
先统计每个价格的出现次数cnt；T从1枚举到最大价格的两倍：包数先取cnt[T]，再对x从max(1,T−最大价格)到min(最大价格,(T−1)/2)累加min(cnt[x],cnt[T−x])，若T为偶数再加上cnt[T/2]除以2；用它更新答案。总计算量约为值域的平方，足够快。
en: Prices are at most 2000, so the target T is at most 4000 and can simply be enumerated. With T fixed, price x can only pair with price T-x, and different price pairs do not interfere.

For each T: every item priced exactly T is a bundle by itself; prices x < T-x give min(cnt[x], cnt[T-x]) bundles; when x = T-x, items of that price pair up among themselves for cnt[x]/2 bundles. Add these up and take the best T.

Count each price into cnt. For T from 1 to twice the maximum price: start with cnt[T], add min(cnt[x], cnt[T-x]) for x from max(1, T - max) to min(max, (T-1)/2), and if T is even add cnt[T/2]/2; update the answer. The work is about the square of the value range, which is fast enough.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Enumerate T = 1..2max(cost), counting the single-item bundles priced T. For each pair of distinct complementary prices take the smaller frequency; for equal prices take half the frequency.

## Proof of correctness

Once T is fixed, a price can only be paired with its unique complementary price, and different pairs share no items. Prices are positive, so a single item priced T cannot take part in a two-item bundle of total T. Therefore the maximum number of bundles of each group can be taken independently and summed, and then T is enumerated.

## Complexity

Time O(n+V^2), space O(V), V<=2000.
